read.en: Teradyne rose 12.7% on Nov 9 to $246.00, trading between $222.47 and $247.48. It is above the falling 5-day ($239.5) and below the falling 10-day ($266.6), 30-day ($338.6) and 100-day ($365.6) averages and the rising 200-day ($350.0). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($257.21), and RSI is 34.
read.zh: 泰瑞达 11月9日上涨 12.7%，收于 $246.00，盘中区间 $222.47–247.48。股价位于下行的 5 日均线（$239.5）上方，下行的 10 日（$266.6）、30 日（$338.6）和 100 日均线（$365.6）以及上行的 200 日均线（$350.0）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方且在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$257.21），RSI 为 34。

read.en: The jump broke the $227 and $234.5–242.1 resistances (Jan 26 low; Jan 29–Feb 2 lows, Nov 5 high), now support, and closed at the $245.9–247.5 zone. Resistance is $245.9–247.5, then $257.2–257.8 (SAR, Nov 2 low) and $266.4–266.6 (Nov 3 low, 10-day). Support is $238.8–242.1, then $227 and $211.6–212.6. A close above $247.5 would target $257–258; below $238.8, $227.

r.en: Nov 4 low $245.9; Feb 3 low $246.8; Nov 9 high $247.48
